MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES FOR WEDNESDAY, APR-18-2006: DAVID G. MENDEZ, ESQ. APPEARS FOR PLAINTIFF, WHO REMAINS ON TELEPHONE STAND-BY DURING THE LENGTH OF THE SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE; J. HARMOND HUGHEY, ESQ. APPEARS ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT JON PYZEL, WHO IS PRESENT THIS DAY.

SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE HELD; THE CASE SETTLES; TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT ARE PLACED ON THE RECORD AND INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING: DEFENDANT MR. JON PYZEL IS TO CONTINUE TO RESIDE AT 56 MASON STREET, UNIT #412, S.F., CA, AND IS TO COOPERATE IN ABATING AN INFESTATION PROBLEM AT THE PREMISE AND IS TO DISPOSE OF RUBBISH IN THE UNIT; ADDITIONALLY, DEFENDANT PYZEL IS TO ALLOW PLAINTIFF TO VISIT THE ROOM APPROXIMATELY EVERY TWO WEEKS. DEFENDANT PYZEL IS TO VACATE THE PREMISE BY AUG-31-2006; NO OTHER OCCUPANT OTHER THAN THE DEFENDANT IS TO RESIDE IN THE UNIT; THERE IS A MUTUAL RELEASE OF CLAIMS BETWEEN THE PARTIES; THE DEFENDANT IS TO OWE NO RENT OR OWE ANY PAST RENT. IF THE DEFENDANT FAILS TO COMPLY WITH THE ABOVE TERMS, PLAINTIFF MAY FILE AN EX PARTE ACTION FOR RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES. PLAINTIFF TO GIVE A 24-HOUR NOTICE TO DEFENDANT IN ORDER TO REMOVE A THREE-DRAWER NIGHTSTAND AND DRESSER FROM THE PREMISE BY APR-25-2006, WITH THE 24-NOTICE TO DEFENDANT. COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF DAVID G. MENDEZ, ESQ.IS TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT THE SIGNED PAPERS CONFIRMING THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. DEFENDANT JON PYZEL INFORMS THE COURT HE AGREES WITH THE TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT REACHED THIS DATE.

JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID ELIGATOR; REPORTER: MS. GEMA EALES, C.S.R. 176; CLERK MARJORIE MANZELLA (218/206).
